about_pullquote: Started this business because I saw homeowners ripped off by cowboys charging through the nose.
about_para_1: First Call Plumbing has been serving Sunderland homes and businesses for over 12 years. We built our reputation on one simple idea: turn up fast, do the job right, and charge a fair price. Every engineer carries the main parts needed for repairs, so we often fix faults while we're there — no return visits, no hidden costs.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we answer our phone 24 hours a day and mean it. Whether it's 3am on a Sunday or a Tuesday afternoon, we treat your emergency like it's our own. We're Gas Safe Registered, fully insured, and proud to be a local family business that knows Sunderland's streets and pipes.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on Boxing Day evening — thought I was stuffed. Called First Call and they were at my house within 50 minutes. Fixed it properly, not a bodge job. Couldn't ask for better service at that time of year. Brilliant lads.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler urgently in November. They quoted fair, installed it in a day, and the paperwork was all sorted. Heating is working perfectly now and the bill's dropped already. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: My radiators were cold at the bottom for years. They came, power flushed the system, and now the whole house is warm. Even explained what was wrong without talking down to me. Proper professional outfit.
reviews.author: David C.
